take-hold.description: Take a named hold that every session of this daemon sees, such as a quiet window for timing runs. A script runs check-hold first, and a pane waits with wait-for hold-released. The hold ends when its holder releases it, when its ttl ends, or when the holder pane closes. Taking a hold the caller already has renews it with the new reason and ttl. A pane needs the grant send-agent-message needs.

params.name: name
params.description: The hold's name: 1 to 64 letters, digits and . _ : -, starting with a letter or a digit.

params.name: reason
params.description: What the hold is for, at most 200 characters. Panes that wait and check-hold show it.

params.name: ttl
params.description: Milliseconds until the hold ends on its own, at most 604800000 (7 days). A caller in no pane must pass it, because no pane closes to end its hold.

returns.name: renewed
returns.description: True when the caller already had the hold and this call renewed it.

returns.name: hold
returns.description: The hold: name, reason, holder (the window id of the holder pane), holder_name, holder_session, holder_host (a linked machine), holder_plugin, holder_pid, label (the holder in words), taken_at and expires_at (Unix nanoseconds, expires_at omitted for no ttl).

release-hold.description: Release a named hold. A name no one holds is not an error: released is false. Releasing another holder's hold needs the admin grant and force. A caller in no pane counts as admin unless its connection is restricted.

params.name: force
params.description: Release the hold when another holder has it. Without it the call fails with held and names the holder.

returns.name: released
returns.description: True when the hold was released, false when no one held it.

returns.name: hold
returns.description: The hold that was released, as take-hold gives it.

check-hold.description: Check that no one holds a named hold. A free name answers with held false. A held name fails with the held code, and the message names the holder, the reason, the age and the time left. A build script runs it first and stops on the failure.

returns.name: held
returns.description: False: a held name fails with the held code instead.

list-holds.description: List the holds this daemon keeps, oldest first. list-agents gives the same rows in holds.

returns.name: holds
returns.description: One row per hold, as take-hold gives it.
